Vendors Teamtailor Accept these cookies Decline all non-necessary cookies Marketing · Main Office (Petah Tiqwa) Senior User Acquisition Manager Apply for this job Help shape the next chapter of growth at Fitness22. Fitness22 is a leading mobile app developer behind a portfolio of health and fitness apps with over 100 million downloads worldwide. We’re looking for a Senior User Acquisition Manager to help scale our acquisition efforts and unlock new growth opportunities. You’ll work directly with senior leadership, move quickly from idea to execution, and have the freedom to make a real impact. About the Role This is a hands-on role with ownership across two core growth channels: Paid acquisition across Meta, TikTok, Apple Search Ads, and Google App Campaigns. Publisher partnerships , including affiliate networks, influencers, and performance partners. We’re looking for someone who thinks beyond campaign optimization and understands how acquisition connects to onboarding, conversion, retention, and long-term customer value. What You’ll Do Own strategy, execution, optimization, and budget allocation across Meta, TikTok, Apple Ads, and Google App Campaigns. Optimize our publisher ecosystem by monitoring performance and traffic quality, and growing a reliable acquisition channel. Work with our data expert and develop reporting that connects marketing investment to business outcomes, including installs, trials, subscriptions, retention, and LTV, using AppsFlyer and internal analytics. Partner closely with Product to improve onboarding, paywalls, and conversion flows, because acquisition doesn’t stop at the install. Lead creative testing together with our in-house Design team to continuously improve performance. What You’ll Bring 4+ years of hands-on User Acquisition experience for mobile apps . Experience with subscription products is a strong advantage. Strong experience managing performance campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Apple Search Ads, and Google App Campaigns, with ownership of meaningful budgets and clear performance goals. Experience with affiliate or publisher partnerships. Strong understanding of mobile attribution platforms such as AppsFlyer and modern measurement methodologies. Excellent analytical skills, with confidence working with cohort analysis, funnel metrics, spreadsheets, and LTV models. A curious, data-driven mindset with a passion for experimentation, ownership, and continuous learning. Availability to work on-site, full-time, five days a week in our Petah Tikva office (next to the light rail). Nice to Have Experience with web-to-app acquisition funnels and web subscription products. Experience in the health, fitness, or wellness industry. Experience with ESPs or self-hosted email infrastructure such as Amazon SES, Sendy, or similar platforms. Why Join Us? Make a direct impact on products used by millions of people worldwide. Own meaningful budgets and growth initiatives with real business influence. Work directly with senior leadership in a fast-moving, no-bureaucracy environment. Join a profitable, independent company where great ideas can quickly become reality. Department Marketing Locations Main Office (Petah Tiqwa) About Fitness22 At Fitness22, we build health and fitness apps used by millions of people worldwide. Our products help users move more, train smarter, and build sustainable habits- combining technology, data, and thoughtful design to make healthy living more accessible. Own meaningful technical challenges and help shape the future of our platform with AI. Apply for this job Senior Full Stack Developer Build technology that helps millions of people change their lives Every day, millions of people use Fitness22 products to get stronger, become healthier, and build habits that last. Building products at that scale creates meaningful engineering challenges. Performance matters. Reliability matters. Architecture matters. And the systems you build directly affect the experience people have every day. We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer who wants to take ownership of those challenges and help us build products that work exceptionally well at scale. Fitness22 is a profitable, bootstrapped product company that’s been building mobile fitness and wellness products since 2011, with more than 100 million downloads worldwide. We’re a small team, which means engineers aren’t several layers removed from the product. You’ll work directly with Product, Design, Mobile, and Data, have real ownership over what you build, and see your work reach users quickly. About the role This is a backend-first role (approximately 70%) for an experienced Full Stack Developer who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges while still building polished React applications when needed. You’ll design and build scalable backend services that power our mobile products, contribute to modern web applications, and work closely with Product, Design, Mobile, and Data to deliver features from idea to production. You’ll have significant ownership over architecture and technical decisions, with the opportunity to influence how we build, ship, and scale our platform. Our stack Node.js · TypeScript · React · PostgreSQL · MongoDB · AWS · Kubernetes You don’t need experience with every technology in our stack. Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn matter more than matching every tool. What you’ll do Design and build backend services and APIs that support products used by millions. Solve technical challenges around performance, reliability, architecture, and scale. Build primarily with Node.js and TypeScript, and contribute to React applications when needed. Own technical problems from design through implementation and production. Collaborate with Product, Design, Mobile, and Data. Use modern AI tools as part of your development workflow. What we’re looking for 4+ years of professional software development experience. Strong production experience with Node.js and TypeScript. Strong backend engineering fundamentals and experience building production systems and APIs. Full Stack experience and the ability to work with React when needed. Strong engineering judgment, ownership, and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Nice to have Experience with relational or NoSQL databases. AWS, GCP, or other cloud platforms. Kubernetes, microservices, distributed systems, or CI/CD. Mobile development experience. Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Why join Fitness22? Build products that help millions of people live healthier, stronger lives. Work in a small engineering team where your decisions matter, your work reaches users quickly, and you can have real influence over both the technology and the product. What You'll Be Doing: Design, develop and maintain high‑quality iOS applications using Swift and modern iOS frameworks, ensuring performance, reliability and accessibility. Lead technical design and architecture for mobile features, collaborating with Product, Design, Backend Engineering and QA to define requirements and delivery plans. Implement robust automated tests (unit, integration and UI) and contribute to continuous integration and deployment pipelines to maintain a high standard of quality. Drive improvements in app performance, crash reduction and battery efficiency through profiling, monitoring and optimisation. Collaborate on product discovery, contribute technical input to roadmap decisions, and estimate implementation effort for new features and experiments. Champion best practices for code quality, maintainability and documentation; help define and maintain engineering standards. Support localisation and internationalisation efforts to ensure a consistent experience across markets. What We're Looking For: 5+ years' professional experience developing iOS applications, with a portfolio of shipped apps or significant feature contributions - Mandatory Strong proficiency in Swift and familiarity with Objective‑C interop, iOS SDKs, UIKit and/or SwiftUI. Experience with architecture patterns such as MVVM, VIPER or coordinator patterns, ability to make pragmatic architecture decisions for product and team scale. Solid understanding of concurrency (GCD, Combine, async/await), memory management and performance optimisation on iOS. Practical experience with testing strategies (unit, UI, snapshot), CI/CD tools and mobile release processes (App Store Connect, TestFlight). Comfort working with RESTful APIs, GraphQL or WebSocket integrations; familiarity with JSON, Codable and networking libraries. Experience mentoring peers, conducting code reviews and contributing to an inclusive engineering culture. Excellent communication skills in English and a collaborative mindset working across product, design and analytics. Nice-to-have: Experience with SwiftUI and animation frameworks for rich, high‑quality UI experiences. Familiarity with mobile analytics, A/B testing frameworks and feature flagging systems. Knowledge of native libraries for audio, video, workouts or sensor data integration (HealthKit, CoreMotion). Experience working on consumer health, fitness or wellbeing products and understanding of related privacy and regulatory considerations. Experience with cross‑platform tooling (e.g., Kotlin Multiplatform Mobile) or contributing to multi‑platform strategies.
